Conclusions Findings of this multi-omics study suggested an intricate interplay between telomere length, metabolism and immune responses, providing valuable insights into the molecular underpinnings of the early-life biological aging.</abstract>

<abstract>Abstract Background: Frailty reflects reduced physiological resilience and increased vulnerability to stressors, functioning as a key biological marker of ageing. Yet, the molecular and causal mechanisms linking frailty to chronic inflammatory conditions remain unclear.
